title: 残心 Zanshin
focus: In Japanese martial arts, Zanshin (残心) literally means "remaining mind." It describes the awareness, presence and attention that continue even after an action has been completed.
practicePrompt: In Aikido, when we finish a technique, we do not simply switch off. Our posture, centre, awareness and connection with our partner remain. The movement may have ended, but our attention continues.
